Name: GAME_AREA_PARAM_ST
Description: Boss rewards and boss state for multiplayer. The row ID is the boss ID passed by the boss-defeat event command (retail: the boss's entity ID, which also matches its defeat flag); −1 uses row 0. PlayRegionParam Boss IDs 1–16 also point here.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Development flag for network-test builds. Not read by the retail game.
Padding.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Bonus Runes - Singleplayer
Fields.Description: Runes awarded when the boss is defeated. If the boss's NpcParam has Boss Rune Award set, its Base Runes are added; the total is then scaled by the usual rune multipliers. Used in single player and multiplayer.

Fields.Name: Bonus Runes - Multiplayer
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: the boss reward always uses Bonus Runes - Singleplayer. Retail sets it on 207 rows.

Fields.Name: Humanity Point Count Flag ID

Fields.Name: Solo Invasion Points Gained - Min
Fields.Description: When the boss is defeated outside multiplayer, a random number of solo invasion points between Min and Max (inclusive) is added, capped by GameSystemCommonParam Maximum Solo Intrusion Point.

Fields.Name: Solo Invasion Points Gained - Max
Fields.Description: Upper end of the random solo invasion points added on defeat (see Min). Retail: 0 on boss rows, so none are added.

Fields.Name: Boss Defeat Flag - For Purpose List
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: the multiplayer purpose list's boss text lookup always returns no text.

Fields.Name: Display Purpose Flag ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (see Boss Defeat Flag - For Purpose List).

Fields.Name: Discovered Boss Flag ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (see Boss Defeat Flag - For Purpose List).

Fields.Name: Discovered Boss Text ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (see Boss Defeat Flag - For Purpose List).

Fields.Name: Undiscovered Boss Text ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (see Boss Defeat Flag - For Purpose List).

Fields.Name: Boss Challenge Flag ID
Fields.Description: The boss only counts as open for summoning and invasions while this flag is on. 0: always.

Fields.Name: Boss Defeat Flag ID
Fields.Description: The boss counts as open for summoning and invasions while this flag is off. A play region with Boss IDs allows multiplayer while at least one of its bosses is open; invasion points are auto-generated near the nearest open boss.

Fields.Name: Boss Coordinate X
Fields.Description: Boss X position, relative to the boss map below. Used to find the nearest open boss when invasion points are auto-generated.

Fields.Name: Boss Coordinate Y
Fields.Description: Boss Y position, relative to the boss map below. Used to find the nearest open boss when invasion points are auto-generated.

Fields.Name: Boss Coordinate Z
Fields.Description: Boss Z position, relative to the boss map below. Used to find the nearest open boss when invasion points are auto-generated.

Fields.Name: Boss Map - Area
Fields.Description: First number of the map the boss position is relative to (mXX_00_00_00).

Fields.Name: Boss Map - Block
Fields.Description: Second number of the map the boss position is relative to (m00_XX_00_00; grid X for open-world maps).

Fields.Name: Boss Map - Region
Fields.Description: Third number of the map the boss position is relative to (m00_00_XX_00; grid Z for open-world maps). The fourth number is always 00.
